verses.text: Early in the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, this message came to Jeremiah from the LORD.
This is what the LORD said to me: "Make a yoke out of straps and wooden bars, and put it on your neck.
Then send messages to the kings of Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre, and Sidon through the messengers who have come to Jerusalem to Zedekiah king of Judah.
Give them a message for their masters: 'This is what the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: Tell your masters this:
By my great power and my outstretched arm I made the earth, and the people and animals on it. I give it to anyone I choose.
Now I have handed all these lands over to my servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon. I have even made the wild animals serve him.
All nations will serve him, his son, and his grandson, until the time comes for his own land to fall. Then many nations and great kings will make him their slave.

If any nation or kingdom will not serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon or put its neck under his yoke, I will punish that nation with war, famine, and disease, says the LORD, until I have destroyed it by his hand.
So do not listen to your prophets, your fortune-tellers, your dreams, your mediums, or your sorcerers who tell you, "You will not serve the king of Babylon."
They are prophesying lies to you. They will only cause you to be taken far from your land. I will drive you out, and you will die.
But if any nation puts its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and serves him, I will let that nation stay in its own land to farm it and live there, says the LORD.'"
I gave the same message to Zedekiah king of Judah. I said, "Put your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon. Serve him and his people, and you will live.
Why should you and your people die by war, famine, and disease, as the LORD has said will happen to any nation that will not serve the king of Babylon?
Do not listen to the prophets who tell you, 'You will not serve the king of Babylon,' because they are prophesying lies to you.
'I did not send them,' says the LORD. 'They are prophesying lies in my name. So I will drive you out, and you will die, both you and the prophets who prophesy to you.'"

Then I said to the priests and to all these people, "This is what the LORD says: Do not listen to your prophets who say, 'Look, the things from the LORD's temple will soon be brought back from Babylon.' They are prophesying lies to you.
Do not listen to them. Serve the king of Babylon, and you will live. Why should this city become a ruin?

If they really are prophets and have the LORD's word, let them pray to the LORD of Armies that the things still left in the LORD's temple, in the palace of the king of Judah, and in Jerusalem will not be taken to Babylon.
For this is what the LORD of Armies says about the pillars, the large bronze basin called the Sea, the stands, and the other things left in this city,
which Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon did not take when he took Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, into exile from Jerusalem to Babylon, along with all the nobles of Judah and Jerusalem.
Yes, this is what the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says about the things left in the LORD's temple, in the palace of the king of Judah, and in Jerusalem:
'They will be taken to Babylon, and they will stay there until the day I come for them,' says the LORD. 'Then I will bring them back and return them to this place.'"
